title:
From footage
to follow-through.
tag: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon · built Oct 29–Nov 3, 2026
narration: A camera can record an event without getting help to the right person. EduSphere Safety connects real video tracking to evidence, staff review, and a recorded response.

title:
Track real footage.
Make action accountable.
tag: Hosted SAM 3.1 tracking → source-bound edge rules → staff response
narration: Meta SAM three point one tracks people in a recorded clip. The edge agent checks the source and applies zone rules. Our API stores incidents and evidence. Local Meta Llama drafts a briefing, while staff control the response.

title:
A school-specific
safety console.
narration: This is the running Next.js console backed by our dot net API and PostgreSQL. We sign in as the school safety officer. The overview shows devices, monitoring coverage, and incidents for this school.

title:
A zone. A schedule.
A repeatable rule.
narration: The school configures a zone, schedule, confidence threshold, and persistence. This versioned bundle names SAM three point one. Multiple frames must support the configured rule before it produces an event.

title:
Real people.
Model track IDs.
tag: Real SAM 3.1 API output · OpenCV public sample · 12-second recording, not local CCTV
narration: Here, Meta SAM three point one tracks real people in a twelve-second public OpenCV recording. These boxes and IDs came from an actual API call. All one hundred and twenty frames returned tracks, with eight IDs across the clip. Our edge agent checks the source and evaluates the tracks, producing six events for this demonstration zone.

title:
One event.
One incident.
tag: Recorded application · explicit handoff of one real SAM event
narration: We select one actual SAM zone event. An explicit demo handoff sends it to the API and retries it. Both requests return one incident. The record retains model version SAM three point one.

title:
Context before
action.
bullets: Same real clip uploaded as evidence
tag: Recorded application · supplied real sample clip · automatic extraction remains future work
narration: This is the same real clip, uploaded with the event through the evidence API. Playback uses an authorized, short-lived link, and access is logged. The recording gives staff context. Automatic live-camera clip extraction remains future work.

title:
A briefing.
A checklist.
Clear unknowns.
tag: Real local Llama inference · inference wait shortened in the edit
narration: Meta Llama drafts an incident briefing locally. It receives only authorized event metadata, with no video. The structured result gives staff a summary, review steps, and explicit unknowns. It cannot change the incident or take action. Staff verify the draft against the evidence.

title:
Acknowledge.
Investigate. Resolve.
bullets: Actor and note recorded in activity
narration: The officer acknowledges the incident, adds an investigation note, and resolves it. Each transition checks the current version to prevent conflicting updates. The database records the actor and activity. Acknowledgement cancels pending escalation, connecting this real video event to an accountable response.

title:
Get the supervisor's
attention.
tag: Production supervisor-alert integrations planned · current demo verifies local email pickup
narration: In production, a configured pool-zone event could route an urgent alert to a supervisor by phone, SMS, or a site alarm. This demo verifies local email pickup, escalation settings, and the evidence access log.

title:
Working prototype.
Clear next steps.
tag: 518 .NET tests + 6 Python tests passed · real SAM API and edge workflow verified
narration: Five hundred and eighteen dot net tests and six Python tests pass. This validates a recorded-clip workflow. Field accuracy, continuous cameras, automatic delivery, and production sign-in remain next steps.

title:
Make the response
part of the record.
tag: Assistive detection. Human decisions. Accountable response.
narration: Built with Meta SAM and Llama, EduSphere Safety records the response. Staff remain in control.
